title: The Real Reason You 'Choke' Under Pressure
hook: Your brain works less efficiently when you are under pressure.

narration.text: Your brain works less efficiently when you are under pressure.
This is not about a lack of skill or confidence.
Instead, stress can overwhelm your brain's working memory.
That is the mental workspace used for complex tasks.
It means you overthink simple actions, making mistakes.
This can happen in sports, public speaking, or exams.
Recognising this can help you manage stressful situations better.
Have you experienced this feeling of choking under pressure?

description: Ever wondered why you sometimes 'choke' during important moments, even when you know exactly what to do? It turns out, stress can actually make your brain work less efficiently, specifically impacting your working memory. This isn't about skill, but about how your mind processes information under pressure.
topic: Why you sometimes 'choke under pressure' during a performance.
